scope: Prespecified paired synthetic-versus-measured RIR training augmentation for the existing80ms INT8 embedding track. No microphone/final scores or waveform speed changes. Different from GPU10ms MicroFrontend training.
question: Does replacing one matched synthetic room training view by a public measured room view improve acoustic generalization without harming frozen development comparisons?
rir_attribution: MIT Computational Audition Lab measured environmental impulse responses; pinned16kHz mirror already used by GPU research. Raw response files stay local; no RIR redistribution.

pairing.population: 10070 original training TTS sources only; no validation/test/microphone source enters extraction.
pairing.control: Add one exact completed variant3 synthetic-room array per original source, verified by hash. Existing original/environment views remain unchanged.
pairing.treatment: Add corresponding variant3 measured-room array, preserving source/background draw, bandpass, SNR, scalar level and all original random draws.
pairing.measured_response: Independent uniform draw across270 pinned training-only responses. Remove leading samples before first magnitude within20dB of peak. Retain remaining response, scale L2 energy to exactly the original per-job synthetic response before convolution; keep renderer output duration unchanged.
pairing.timebase: Original16000Hz PCM/speech rate,2.4slead,1stail and keyword-end metadata unchanged. Reverb tails may be truncated by the existing fixed renderer window.
pairing.audit: Replay first48 interleaved source/label jobs through unmodified renderer/frontend and require byte-exact previous arrays; verify original control array identities for every job, all source/RIR hashes and background pairing.

next_fitting.after: Only after full paired-index/pilot/isolation checks; freeze four matched plans with completed feature hashes before training.
next_fitting.initialization: Same original selected dense/temporal Keras weights for matched control/treatment.
next_fitting.recipe: Existing matched control recipes:10000steps,checkpoints2500/5000/7500/10000; negative_weight5; normal-speed data; no new mining/optimizer/threshold changes.
next_fitting.selection: Same original validation-only calibration/checkpoint policy for both arms, then frozen equal-mean comparison. Keep all subgroup/FAR confidence metrics explicit. No thresholds fitted from microphone/development scores.
next_fitting.gate: Do not flash inferior candidates. Existing paired/English/Mandarin development regression after frozen validation; independent final/human/acoustic/resource/AEC acceptance still required.

limits: This is a new training-data experiment inspired by observed acoustic mismatch; it does not establish the cause of any reused microphone miss.
Room-response shapes and approximate alignment/energy matching do not prove deployment acoustic coverage.
Correlated synthetic views and repeated source voices are not new independent speakers or final acceptance.
